newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-SFE wheat futures lie dormant again, no trade.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-SFE wheat futures lie dormant again, no trade.

text.p: Sydney Futures Exchange (SFE) wheat futures trading was comatose on Thursday with no trades, ahead of the Thanksgiving holiday in the United States today.
"The market has been winding down all week," one trader said. He said this has been due to the Thanksgiving holiday.
"I expect the market to pick up next week," he said.
Wheat lost ground in the United States on news that Sri Lanka and Morocco had bypassed the U.S. in their wheat purchases this week. The purchases were made with Australia and Argentina.
